_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. coinbase.com declares its design layer as the CDS theme on div.coinbase.light and div.coinbase.dark (raw/css-vars.json's themes bin): the eleven primitive ramps (blue, gray, green, orange, red, indigo, pink, purple, teal, yellow, chartreuse), the 54-role semantic colour layer, the space/border-radius/border-width/type scales and the shadow elevations. Semantic roles are emitted from the declared --lightColor-*/--darkColor-* sets and aliased to the measured chrome in raw/components-computed.json where they agree.

control.description: The measured Sign-up pill corner radius.

ui.description: The measured promo-banner link transition — the real UI motion at 0.2s.
The ease-in-out curve on the animated chrome (promo banner, search, menu links).

content.description: The hero column's measure — the widest content element.

page.description: The page ground — the .coinbase.light wrapper's white fill.

onDark.description: White text inside the dark asset panel's chips (fgInverse).

onAccent.description: White text on the blue Sign-up pill (fgInverse).

banner.description: The promo banner's navy link line.

accent.description: The Sign-up pill fill — Coinbase blue (bgPrimary #0052ff).
accent.source: computed backgroundColor of nav-cta default (raw/components-computed.json); same value as core.color.blue.60

accentHover.source: computed backgroundColor of nav-cta hover (raw/components-computed.json); same value as core.color.role.bgBrandHovered

input.description: The sign-in email field's border (bgLineHeavy, fgMuted @ 66%).
input.source: computed paint.0.border of signin-card default (raw/components-computed.json); same value as core.color.role.bgLineHeavy

subtle.description: The hairline rule painted by the nav bar, footer rules and the sign-in OR divider (bgLine, fgMuted @ 20%).

focus.description: The focus outline painted on nav links.

scrim.description: The modal/menu scrim role (bgOverlay, bgInverse @ 33%) — declared only; no overlay was opened signed out.
